{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.head())

# Check for the QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, strip commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out the QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Also filter out refunded orders, since they don't contribute to revenue
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Group by channel and sum revenue
revenue_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Print the full revenue breakdown by channel for evidence
print("Revenue by channel:")
print(revenue_by_channel)

# Find the channel with the highest total revenue
best_channel = revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
max_revenue = revenue_by_channel.max()

# Output the result
print(f"Channel with most revenue: {best_channel} with ${max_revenue:,.2f}")"}
